title: Editing window, versions, pinned human edits, lock time
description:
A Delivery is a draft with an edit window, not a one-shot. The window runs from creation to releaseAt and is set per kind and per channel as data (a weekly newsletter has a week; a story post may have twenty minutes). The machine drafts, people edit; every edit is a new saved version of the Delivery text and none is overwritten. Blocks and lines a person changed are marked owner: human, pinned, and a later machine redraft never overwrites a pinned block (same rule as Story translations). A Delivery may hold several candidate texts or images, one chosen and the others kept (basis for later A/B). At a set time before releaseAt the Delivery locks for the send job and the last approved version is sent; a late edit needs an explicit unlock; the attempt log records which version was sent. Where approval is soft or hard nothing is sent that no person looked at; for none the machine draft goes at releaseAt.

**Acceptance criteria**
- New Gherkin features (to be written with the slice): Edit window and versions (every edit a new version, earlier versions kept); Pinned human edits survive a redraft; Candidate versions (choose one, keep others); Lock time and unlock (late edit refused until unlocked; attempt records the version sent); Nothing unseen is sent under soft or hard approval.
- Window length is data per kind and channel, not code.
- Text and versions live in S3; the row holds keys and hashes.
- Operations available from newsroom and CLI from the one operation table.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
